project.name: Distributed Word Count: mapreduce-coordinator
project.description: The reduce phase, and the fan-out that drives the map phase: a Job-kind module whose single run generates a sizable synthetic text corpus, splits it into chunks, dispatches each chunk to mapreduce-worker over the fabric on its own virtual thread (re-resolving the service for every chunk so the fabric's own load balancer actually spreads them across every live replica), then merges the partial word-count results it gets back into one final report.
